invariants.rationale: If the bucketInfoMap contains the given bucketNumber as key, result must be non-null; otherwise, result is null.
The result is always exactly the value returned by bucketInfoMap.get for the given key.
Bucket numbers representing map keys are usually non-negative.
The method directly delegates to bucketInfoMap.get, which must be non-null.
The number of buckets in the map should not exceed the totalBuckets field.
